name: orders
constraints: CHECK (((list_subtotal_minor >= subtotal_minor) AND (discount_minor = (list_subtotal_minor - subtotal_minor)) AND (((promotion_id IS NULL) AND (promotion_code IS NULL) AND (discount_minor = 0)) OR ((promotion_id IS NOT NULL) AND (promotion_code IS NOT NULL) AND (discount_minor > 0)))))

name: order_items
constraints: CHECK ((((item_type = 'service'::text) AND (service_product_id IS NOT NULL) AND (addon_product_id IS NULL)) OR ((item_type = 'addon'::text) AND (addon_product_id IS NOT NULL) AND (service_product_id IS NULL))))

name: paymob_credential_versions
constraints: CHECK ((((status = 'active'::text) AND (retiring_at IS NULL) AND (valid_until IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'retiring'::text) AND (retiring_at IS NOT NULL) AND (valid_until IS NOT NULL) AND (valid_until > retiring_at)) OR ((status = 'expired'::text) AND (valid_until IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status = 'revoked'::text) AND (revoked_at IS NOT NULL) AND (revocation_reason_code IS NOT NULL))))

name: payment_attempts
constraints: CHECK ((((checkout_flow = 'intention'::text) AND (payment_option = 'hosted'::text) AND (selected_integration_id IS NULL)) OR ((checkout_flow = 'quicklink'::text) AND (payment_option = ANY (ARRAY['card'::text, 'apple_pay'::text])) AND (selected_integration_id IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((provider_expires_at IS NULL) OR ((provider_expires_at > prepared_at) AND (provider_expires_at <= (expires_at - '00:00:30'::interval)))))
CHECK ((((status = 'creating_intention'::text) AND (claim_token IS NOT NULL) AND (claim_expires_at IS NOT NULL)) OR (status <> 'creating_intention'::text)))

CHECK ((((checkout_secret_id IS NULL) AND (checkout_secret_expires_at IS NULL)) OR ((checkout_secret_id IS NOT NULL) AND (checkout_secret_expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND (provider_expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND (checkout_secret_expires_at = provider_expires_at) AND (checkout_secret_expires_at <= expires_at))))

name: payment_provider_configs
constraints: CHECK (((activation_requested_mode IS NULL) OR (activation_requested_mode = ANY (ARRAY['sandbox'::text, 'live'::text])))) NOT VALID

CHECK (((jsonb_typeof(readiness_evidence) = 'object'::text) AND
CASE
    WHEN (provider_key = 'paymob'::text) THEN private_app.paymob_readiness_evidence_safe_v1(readiness_evidence)
    ELSE (NOT private_app.jsonb_has_sensitive_key(readiness_evidence))
END))
